items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I played with a little man. His brother played clarinet, he played guitar, Cat's Mastry played drum.

ctx.x: Is it Gene Hemard or what is his name, Hemard? Gene Ory or whatever he tells himself he used to play with you some? He played guitar. I think he played with you or Red Hot. Maybe I got it confused. He played with Red Hot.

No, the only guitar man I played with was Lil Durfee. Durfee, that's years ago. I played with a little man. His brother played clarinet, he played guitar, Cat's Mastry played drum. I used to play trumpet.
What's his brother's name? Durfee, Frank Durfee. Frank Durfee is a guitar player? And which, wait a minute, I can't get this straight.
